title: A Self-Styled Mother Appeared!
description:
Rookie child adventurers, Ali and Kazam encounter a mysterious woman who seems concerned about them regarding the very first quest they take on.

While the two remain wary of her, the woman, Mami, immediately reveals her true colors:

“Don’t worry. I’m just planning to help you two out and then take you home with me.”

Declaring herself to be their mother, she begins following them around in an attempt to make them give up adventuring altogether...

And so begins a safe and secure fantasy adventure alongside the strongest —and most abnormal— self-proclaimed mom!
author: Susan Shibaike
